payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores for various discourse relations.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The model achieved performance gains of around 2% and 8% on contingency and temporal relations respectively compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model with tensor.
The basic paragraph-level model further improved classification performance on implicit relations, with an additional 1.42% improvement on the contingency relation.
